variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: Document parsing turns files made for people, such as PDFs, scans, forms, and office documents, into structured records that software can validate and use. OCR can recover characters from pixels, but parsing also has to recover reading order, headings, tables, fields, relationships, and the evidence behind each value.
variants.prompt: From the lesson section “Ingestion is a trust boundary”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Identify the source
pairs.detail: Assign a document ID and tenant, hash the original bytes, preserve page or attachment order, and make retries refer to the same revision.
pairs.explanation: Assign a document ID and tenant, hash the original bytes, preserve page or attachment order, and make retries refer to the same revision.

pairs.label: Verify the file
pairs.detail: Compare the allowlisted extension, declared MIME type, file signature, and parser probe.
pairs.explanation: Compare the allowlisted extension, declared MIME type, file signature, and parser probe. Reject malformed or unsupported combinations.

pairs.label: Enforce budgets
pairs.detail: Limit bytes, pages, dimensions, attachments, decompressed size, nesting depth, and processing time before fan-out.
pairs.explanation: Limit bytes, pages, dimensions, attachments, decompressed size, nesting depth, and processing time before fan-out.

pairs.label: Isolate processing
pairs.detail: Run parsers with least privilege, restricted network and filesystem access, patched dependencies, and separate quarantine storage.
pairs.explanation: Run parsers with least privilege, restricted network and filesystem access, patched dependencies, and separate quarantine storage.

pairs.explanation: Render only pages or regions without usable text. Record image transform, OCR engine and model version, language, word boxes, and confidence.

pairs.label: Reading order
pairs.detail: Order blocks through columns, sidebars, captions, footnotes, and page breaks.
pairs.explanation: Order blocks through columns, sidebars, captions, footnotes, and page breaks. Store explicit predecessor relationships when simple coordinates are ambiguous.

pairs.label: Hierarchy
pairs.detail: Connect titles, headings, paragraphs, and list items.
pairs.explanation: Connect titles, headings, paragraphs, and list items. Do not infer heading level from font size alone; repeated styles and numbering also matter.

pairs.label: Fields and forms
pairs.detail: Link each key to its value, preserve check-box state and nearby labels, and distinguish a missing field from a present but empty field.
pairs.explanation: Link each key to its value, preserve check-box state and nearby labels, and distinguish a missing field from a present but empty field.

pairs.label: Tables
pairs.detail: Keep cells, row and column indexes, spans, headers, units, and continuation links.
pairs.explanation: Keep cells, row and column indexes, spans, headers, units, and continuation links. Flatten to CSV only after structural validation.
